text:
Maya (Marketing): Quick check — day-zero plan for the Summit booth. We need actionable owner list for swag staging, demo runs, and speaking pass handoffs.
Ben (Events): Got it. I have the room access window 8:00–10:30am for setup. Courier ETA 6:45am.
Priya (Ops): Courier confirmed for 6:45am, drop at loading dock B. I added a note about pallet tags (red/blue) for demo vs swag.
Sam (Growth): For inbound lead routing: QR leads -> HubSpot form tag `summit-2026`. Can we add a quick checkbox for "demo requested" so SDRs can prioritize?
Maya (Marketing): Yes please. Sam, can you add the checkbox and a UTM template? Example: `?utm_source=summit&utm_campaign=dayzero_demo`
Sam (Growth): Will do. Also prepping a benchmark narrative slide for the talk: want to call out median latency and cost delta vs default configs. Need exact numbers from eng by EOD.
Ben (Events): Swag counts: 600 stickers, 400 shirts (S-XL split in Spreadsheet), 200 notebooks, 50 premium tote bags. Do we ship extras?
Maya (Marketing): Ship +10% shirts and +20% stickers. Keep 30 premium totes at HQ for giveaways.
Priya (Ops): Staging checklist (copying here):
```
- Unpack boxes and verify SKUs (label: SWAG / DEMO)
- Put demo laptops on locked carts with power strips (test HDMI adapters)
- Attach lead QR signage to table stands
- Confirm network fallback (cell hotspot) and private demo VLAN
- Place one spare shirt size S/XL in organizer bag
```
Ben (Events): Demo run cadence: 20-min windows, 3 demos per hour, reserve 10-min buffer between back-to-back sessions. Volunteers: Maya + Ben 9:30–12:30, Sam 1:00–4:00.
Maya (Marketing): Who is handling speaking submission followups? We have 2 accepted slots and 1 waitlist talk — need slide deck review and one-pager by tomorrow noon.
Sam (Growth): I'll coordinate deck review. @Ben can you confirm AV requirements for the big room? I think it's 16:9, clicker, lav mic.
Ben (Events): Confirmed: projector 16:9, wired clicker, lapel + handheld mics. We need to bring a Type-C HDMI dongle and 3m extension for the demo table.
Maya (Marketing): Social launch posts: pre-event teaser (Mon), live demo clip (Wed), post-event benchmarks + writeup (Fri). Draft captions in the comms doc — tag: `marketing/summit-campaign`.
Priya (Ops): EventBot: delivery status?
EventBot: Courier updated — manifest scanned at 6:12am, 3 packages flagged fragile. ETA at dock B 6:45am. Tracking: https://courier.example/track/ZX-2112
Sam (Growth): Messaging iteration: we'll A/B headline for the booth — Option A: "Predictable LLM inference at scale" vs Option B: "Run production LLMs with reliable latency & lower cost". We should test both in paid social.
Maya (Marketing): Good. Also patch the one-liner for MC intros to mention Dedicated and Private options briefly. Keep it under 15s.
Ben (Events): Will the booth have a demo queue or signups?
Maya (Marketing): Signups via QR only (no paper). We'll surface next-available demo time in the form and let SDRs manually schedule follow-ups for "demo requested" leads.
Priya (Ops): Final logistics: power strips x4, cable ties, gaffer tape, spare 5A fuses, toolkit, sanitizer. I put them in the event kit bag.
Maya (Marketing): Cool. Action items recap: Sam add HubSpot checkbox + UTM, Ben bring dongles & confirm AV, Priya manage courier & event kit, Sam + Maya review slides by noon, Marketing to post teaser Monday. Everyone: please react with :thumbsup: when done.
Ben (Events): :thumbsup:
Sam (Growth): :thumbsup:
Priya (Ops): :thumbsup:
Maya (Marketing): Thanks team — see you bright and early.
